questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
I chose Switzerland as my study destination because of several crucial aspects:

Firstly, the multicultural environment of Switzerland, with its four official languages and diverse population, intrigued me. I was eager to immerse myself in such a rich cultural tapestry, believing it would provide a unique learning experience and foster my cultural understanding and global perspectives.

Moreover, Switzerland's high quality of life, excellent healthcare, safety standards, and overall standard of living were appealing factors. The opportunity to live and study in a country known for its exceptional quality of life was something I valued greatly.

Furthermore, Switzerland's breathtaking natural beauty, including the Swiss Alps, pristine lakes, and picturesque towns, offered ample opportunities for outdoor recreation and exploration. I was drawn to the idea of studying in a country renowned for its natural landscapes and outdoor activities.

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
Economics field:
I copenhagen the level of theory is much higher than in Bern. I found myself having an easier time wrapping my head around econometric theory than my peers. However, they seem to be very strong when it comes to application of theories. It was really nice to experience this difference. The level was in general 'right-on' for me.
